problems.title: Implement Queue using Array

description.en: Implement a queue using a fixed-size array with enqueue, dequeue, front, and isEmpty operations.
description.hi: Fixed-size array se queue implement karo jisme enqueue, dequeue, front, aur isEmpty operations ho.

explanation.en: Queue follows FIFO so 1 is removed first; after removal front is 2.
explanation.hi: Queue FIFO follow karta hai isliye 1 pehle remove hota hai; remove ke baad front 2 hai.

constraints: Use a circular array of size 1000

hints.en: Use front and rear indices. Use modulo for circular behavior.
hints.hi: Front aur rear indices use karo. Circular behavior ke liye modulo use karo.

        self.capacity = capacity

    def dequeue(self): pass

approach.en: Use a circular array. Rear advances with (rear+1)%capacity on enqueue. Front advances with (front+1)%capacity on dequeue. Track size separately.
approach.hi: Circular array use karo. Enqueue par rear (rear+1)%capacity se advance hota hai. Dequeue par front (front+1)%capacity se advance hota hai. Size alag track karo.

code.python:
class Queue:
    def __init__(self, capacity=1000):
        self.arr = [0] * capacity
        self.front = 0; self.rear = -1; self.size = 0; self.capacity = capacity
    def enqueue(self, x):
        self.rear = (self.rear + 1) % self.capacity
        self.arr[self.rear] = x; self.size += 1
    def dequeue(self):
        v = self.arr[self.front]
        self.front = (self.front + 1) % self.capacity
        self.size -= 1; return v
    def get_front(self): return self.arr[self.front]
    def is_empty(self): return self.size == 0

q = Queue()
q.enqueue(1); q.enqueue(2); q.enqueue(3)
print(q.dequeue())   # 1
print(q.get_front()) # 2

problems.title: Implement Queue using Stack

description.en: Implement a FIFO queue using only two stacks. Implement push, pop, peek, and empty operations.
description.hi: Sirf do stacks use karke FIFO queue implement karo. push, pop, peek aur empty operations implement karo.

explanation.en: Queue is FIFO so peek and pop return the first pushed element.
explanation.hi: Queue FIFO hai isliye peek aur pop pehle push kiya element return karte hain.

constraints: At most 100 calls to push, pop, peek, and empty

hints.en: Use two stacks: input and output. On pop/peek, transfer all from input to output if output is empty.
hints.hi: Do stacks use karo: input aur output. Pop/peek par, agar output empty hai toh sab input se output mein transfer karo.

starterCode.python:
class MyQueue:
    def __init__(self):
        self.s1 = []
        self.s2 = []
    def push(self, x): pass
    def pop(self): pass
    def peek(self): pass
    def empty(self): return not self.s1 and not self.s2

approach.en: Use s1 for push. For pop/peek, if s2 is empty, pour all of s1 into s2 (reversing order gives FIFO). Then pop/peek from s2. This gives amortized O(1).
approach.hi: Push ke liye s1 use karo. Pop/peek ke liye, agar s2 empty hai, s1 ka sab s2 mein daalo (order reverse hoke FIFO milta hai). Phir s2 se pop/peek karo. Yeh amortized O(1) deta hai.

code.python:
from collections import deque
from typing import List
def generate_binary_numbers(n: int) -> List[str]:
    q = deque(['1']); result = []
    for _ in range(n):
        s = q.popleft(); result.append(s)
        q.append(s + '0'); q.append(s + '1')
    return result

description.en: Design a circular queue with a given capacity. Implement enQueue, deQueue, Front, Rear, isEmpty, and isFull operations.
description.hi: Diye gaye capacity ka circular queue design karo. enQueue, deQueue, Front, Rear, isEmpty, aur isFull operations implement karo.

explanation.en: Capacity 3: after 3 enqueues the queue is full; after dequeue, enqueue(4) succeeds.
explanation.hi: Capacity 3: 3 enqueues ke baad queue full hai; dequeue ke baad, enqueue(4) succeed hota hai.

hints.en: Use an array of size k with front, rear, and size variables.
hints.hi: k size ka array use karo front, rear, aur size variables ke saath.

starterCode.python:
class MyCircularQueue:
    def __init__(self, k: int):
        self.arr = [0] * k
        self.front = 0; self.rear = -1; self.size = 0; self.cap = k
    def enQueue(self, value: int) -> bool: pass
    def deQueue(self) -> bool: pass
    def Front(self) -> int: pass
    def Rear(self) -> int: pass
    def isEmpty(self) -> bool: return self.size == 0
    def isFull(self) -> bool: return self.size == self.cap

approach.en: Use circular indexing: rear = (rear+1)%cap on enqueue, front = (front+1)%cap on dequeue. Track size to differentiate full vs empty.
approach.hi: Circular indexing use karo: enqueue par rear = (rear+1)%cap, dequeue par front = (front+1)%cap. Full vs empty differentiate karne ke liye size track karo.

code.python:
class MyCircularQueue:
    def __init__(self,k): self.arr=[0]*k;self.front=0;self.rear=-1;self.size=0;self.cap=k
    def enQueue(self,v):
        if self.isFull(): return False
        self.rear=(self.rear+1)%self.cap;self.arr[self.rear]=v;self.size+=1;return True
    def deQueue(self):
        if self.isEmpty(): return False
        self.front=(self.front+1)%self.cap;self.size-=1;return True
    def Front(self): return -1 if self.isEmpty() else self.arr[self.front]
    def Rear(self): return -1 if self.isEmpty() else self.arr[self.rear]
    def isEmpty(self): return self.size==0
    def isFull(self): return self.size==self.cap

problems.title: Design Hit Counter

description.en: Design a hit counter that counts the number of hits received in the past 5 minutes (300 seconds). Implement hit(timestamp) and getHits(timestamp) functions.
description.hi: Ek hit counter design karo jo pichhle 5 minutes (300 seconds) mein receive hui hits count kare. hit(timestamp) aur getHits(timestamp) functions implement karo.

explanation.en: At timestamp 301, hit at t=1 is more than 300 seconds old and is excluded.
explanation.hi: Timestamp 301 par, t=1 ki hit 300 seconds se zyada purani hai aur exclude ho jaati hai.

constraints: All calls to hit and getHits are in chronological order

hints.en: Use a queue to store timestamps. On getHits, remove all timestamps older than 300 seconds from current.
hints.hi: Timestamps store karne ke liye queue use karo. getHits par, current se 300 seconds se zyada purane sab timestamps remove karo.

approach.en: Store hit timestamps in a queue. For getHits(t), remove all timestamps <= t-300 from the front (they are older than 5 minutes). Return queue size.
approach.hi: Hit timestamps queue mein store karo. getHits(t) ke liye, front se sab timestamps <= t-300 remove karo (5 minutes se zyada purane hain). Queue size return karo.
